test_debug.phy_discovery: Read Status Register (Reg 1) and PHY Identifier (Reg 2 / Reg 3) to discover the attached PHY
test_debug.link_status: Read Link Status (BMSR Reg 1 bit 2) and Auto-Negotiation Complete (bit 5)
test_debug.loopback: Set BMCR bit 14 to put the PHY in loopback for test
test_debug.phy_reset: Write BMCR (Reg 0) bit 15 = 1 to reset the PHY; the bit self-clears
